detail: First and Final Liquidation and Distribution Account in the estate of the late ROBERT PAUL LERENA of Newlands, Cape, who died on the 19th March 1950
Rose Lilian Theys, spinster, of No. 7 Forth Road, Newlands, C.P. - the same address as the deceased; described in the distribution as "no relation"
14,450 pounds 3s 7d, divided into four equal shares of 3,612 pounds 5s 11d
LOUIS LERENA, major son - one half of a share, 1,806 pounds 3s 0d
ROSE LILIAN THEYS, no relation - one half of a share, 1,806 pounds 2s 11d
10,837 pounds 17s 8d (three quarters) to Rose Lilian Theys as Administratrix upon trust for the residuary heirs NUNO FERNANDO LERENA and RICHARDO JUAN CARLOS LERENA, major sons
Capital payable only when Nuno Fernando Lerena attains the age of thirty years - i.e. 6 October 1954
300 United Fish Canners Ordinary; 300 United Fish Canners "A"; fixed deposit with S.A. Permanent Mutual Building & Investment Society
W. C. Blake - claim for CARROTS, 26 pounds; Brooklyn Meat Supply; New Bridge Garage; D. Killa & Sons 60 pounds 4s 9d; Funerals (Pty) Ltd 67 pounds 1s; Dr J. R. E. Lee, professional services

Supplied again by David on 13 October 2026 as a page headed SUCCESSION DUTY ADDENDUM: entailed capital of 10,837 pounds 17s 8d subject to usufruct for Ricardo Juan Carlos Lerena (born 6th January 1920) and Nuno Fernando Lerena (born 6th October 1924) until Nuno attains thirty (6 October 1954); testator died 19th March 1950; usufruct four years six months 18 days, 'for duty purposes four years', rate 3.47; 6 percent of the capital 650 pounds 5s 6d, capitalised 2,256 pounds 9s 1d; succession duty at 3 percent 67 pounds 13s 10d. Pencilled workings are not transcribed. THE TYPED FIGURES WERE RECOMPUTED ON 13 OCTOBER 2026 AND HOLD: 6 percent of 10,837.17.8 is 650.27, times 3.47 is 2,256.45 (= 2,256 pounds 9s), and 3 percent of that is 67.69 (= 67 pounds 13s 9.6d, which the page rounds to 10d). It adds no name and no parent: it repeats both sons' birth dates, which the register already held, and the page is not published as an image.
